--- Page 1 (Beckerman_97a) --- Dear Cousin Jack, Let's you & I forget about formalities and sort of start writing each other every once in a while. I was in N.Y a few weeks back, as you probably already know, and found your folks in very good health. Your father was feeling very well and I think we can both be thankful for that. When he first saw me he didn't even recognize me, although your mother thought when she first saw me that you were walking up the stairs. I had a very nice time in N.Y. although I'm sorry that I came at such present times. With Harry going away and Aunt --- Page 2 (Beckerman_97b) --- Sarah carrying one so for a little while - well it was pretty hard to take. I came back to Chicago the same day Harry B. left in hope that I'd be able to see him but he had already left. He'll be stationed down around Little Rock, Ark. not so very far from you is it? I'll be leaving any day now as an aviation cadet. I've been sworn in for almost six months now and am really getting tired waiting. Well I guess that's about all for now. The folks all send their regards. Your cousin Leonard.
